summary: Complete QA for CR-071 (B2B Customer Capture) + CR-072 (Hotel Document Capture). All 12 backend tests passed (T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7 x2, T8, T9, T10, T12, T13). Frontend T11 verified via Playwright — Documents section renders correctly with data-testid='documents-section' in both empty state ('No documents uploaded yet') and populated state (doc-card-aadhaar with doc-download-{id} link). Real S3 uploads worked against mygenie-prod bucket in ap-south-1; signed URLs generated correctly.

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING BUG (not CR-071/CR-072 scope): CustomerCreate/CustomerBase schema is missing `billing_address`, `credit_limit`, `payment_terms` fields, but create_customer() in customers.py:786 accesses `customer_data.billing_address` unconditionally → AttributeError → 500. Reproduces on any POST /api/customers call with a plain payload. Test suite worked around by seeding via POS webhook path instead.

action_items: OPTIONAL (out of scope, but critical for CRM staff): Add billing_address, credit_limit, payment_terms to CustomerBase in models/schemas.py — POST /api/customers is currently 500ing. Alternatively, use .dict().get() defensively in customers.py:786.
critical_code_review_comments: CR-071 VERIFIED: pos.py customer_update_set correctly guards non-empty gst_name/gst_number and sets is_b2b=True + customer_type='corporate' only when gst_number present. T2 confirmed that a subsequent order WITHOUT GST does NOT clobber existing B2B fields (regression protection working).

CR-071 VERIFIED: /api/pos/customer-lookup response now returns customer_type, gst_name, gst_number, is_b2b (flat, top-level) plus documents (grouped dict). All existing lookup fields (name, phone, tier, total_points, wallet_balance, etc.) still present — no regression (T13).
CR-071 VERIFIED: is_b2b field surfaces in both GET /api/customers list and GET /api/customers/{id} detail responses.
CR-071 VERIFIED: /api/whatsapp/variables returns customer_gst_name + customer_gst_number (total variables >= 43).

CR-072 VERIFIED: POST /api/pos/customers/{id}/documents validates doc_type against allow-list (rejects invalid → 400), validates MIME type (rejects text/plain → 400), enforces 5MB max, uploads to S3 as private object, stores metadata in db.customer_documents, prunes oldest when >5 per doc_type (T12: uploaded 6, verified 5 remain), returns signed URL.
CR-072 VERIFIED: GET /api/pos/customers/{id}/documents returns grouped-by-doc_type structure, newest first, with signed URLs (900s expiry).
CR-072 VERIFIED: GET /api/customers/{id}/documents (CRM/JWT endpoint) returns same grouped structure.

CR-072 VERIFIED: Frontend CustomerDetailPage.jsx renders
, shows

No documents uploaded yet

for empty state, and doc-card-{type} + doc-download-{id} links for each uploaded document. Layout is clean, aligned with rest of page.

MINOR: The pos_upload_document handler order: S3_CONFIGURED check happens before doc_type/MIME validation (lines 2130-2146). This is OK, but means if S3 becomes unavailable, tests for invalid doc_type return 503 instead of 400 (test allows both). Not blocking.
MINOR: In customers.py get_customer_documents, no pagination — capped at 100 docs total. With max 5 per type × 6 types = 30 max, so fine in practice.
test_credentials: owner@kunafamahal.com / Qplazm@10 (restaurant_689, pos_id=0001). Login returns {access_token, ...}. POS auth: X-API-Key header via GET /api/pos/api-key. IMPORTANT: POS webhook expects pos_id='0001' (not 'mygenie') and restaurant_id='689' (strip 'restaurant_' prefix from /api/auth/me.id).
seed_data_creation: Test customers auto-created via POS webhook path (unique phone per run). All cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_cr071_cr072.py has 12 tests + helpful fixtures (pos_ids extracts pos_id/restaurant_id from /api/auth/me). Reusable pattern for POS tests. Note pre-existing bug in POST /api/customers (missing billing_address in CustomerBase schema) — bypass by seeding customer via POS webhook.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects in CR-071 or CR-072 implementation. Pre-existing customer-create 500 documented for main agent visibility.
